_about: Links open_link will follow. A link replaces a whole navigation sequence - fewer steps, fewer tokens.
prefix: the URL must start with this. package: the app it must land in; landing anywhere else is an error, not a success.
count / platform (optional): the read this link performs, passed to the policy/reads.py hooks. sample: a harmless value used to verify it.
verified: null until `droidpilot deeplinks --verify` opened it on a real phone and saw the package come to the front. open_link refuses unverified links.

links.note: opens a profile directly; replaces search + typing + tapping a result
opens a public channel or group by handle, joined or not
the app-native form of a t.me handle link; public usernames only
